QuestInfo.name: Faraway Land
QuestInfo.0: It would be best to figure out where you are first. Ask Chief Stan.
QuestInfo.1: Chief Stan says this place is Henesys, and it is located below the Six Path Crossway. Henesys? Six Path Crossway? Everything sounds unfamiliar. He says you need to get the #t4034060# for him to explain things better.
QuestInfo.2: You brought Chief Stan the #t4034060# to get a better explanation.

speech.0: You mean #r#t4034060##k? That's weird. If there's one person who knows Maple World, it's him. Why would... Oh, I bet he'll use that to explain it. He's so clever!
speech.1: What should we do? #bCamila#k asked to borrow the map for geography class. You'll have to go to #bCamila#k and ask for it back.

speech.0: The #r#t4034060##k? Yeah, I took it. But I returned it to #bJay#k after class. Ask him. He's probably reading his books at his home by now.
You need the #r#t4034060##k? Aww, you're like five minutes too late. #bDr. Bruce#k said he needed it for research. He should be at #b#m100040000##k.

0.0: Why are you asking where you are? This is Henesys, cornerstone of Maple society! You must either be joking or... Huh, you look serious.
0.1: Alright, I'll play your little game. Henesys is a town just below the Six Path Crossway. Now that is... You see, it connects... Blast it, I could really use a map for this. Go to my house and fetch me my #r#t4034060##k.

yes.0: Go see my wife, #bMrs. Ming Ming#k, and get my #r#t4034060##k. I can't do it without that map. Tell her I sent you... and that I'm sorry about our anniversary. Again.

no.0: I can't explain any further without my map. I don't have much of a mind for place names. Besides Henesys.

1.0: Did you get the #r#t4034060##k? You took so long I thought you were drawing a map of your own. Which would completely defeat the purpose!

yes.0: Oh... I guess getting the map was harder than I expected. Alright then, you deserve a quality explanation.

default.0: You have to bring me my #r#t4034060##k so I can explain better. That's what you want, right?
